chapter.verse: Tu-in mi khat cina hi. Mary leh a sanggamnu Martha' tenna Bethany khua-a om Lazarus ahi hi.
Mary pen nilhthau tawh Topa nilhin a sam tawh a khe a nulsak numeinu hi a, cina Lazarus pen a sanggampa ahi hi.
Tua hi a, unau numeite in Jesu' kiangah, “Topa aw, na it mipa cina hi,” ci-in kam vaikhak uh hi.
Tua thu a zak ciangin Jesu in, “Hih natna pen sih nading hilo a, Pasian' minphat nading ahi hi. Hih tungtawnin Pasian' Tapa a min kiphat ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in Martha ahi-a a sanggamnu leh Lazarus ahi zongin it mahmah hi.
Tua hangin Lazarus cina cih a zak ciangin a omna mun ah ni nih taambeh hi.
Tua khit, Jesu in a nungzuite' kiangah, “Judea gam va pai kik ni,” ci hi.
Nungzuite in, “Rabbi aw, den mahin Jew mite in suang tawh nang hong den sawm uh hi. Tua tak paikik ding na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Ni khat sungah nai sawmlenih om hilo ahi hiam? Mi khatpeuh sun hun sungin lampai leh hih leitung ii khuavak mu ahih manin kisuikha lo hi.
Ahih hangin mi khatpeuh zan hun sungin lampai leh ama' sungah khuavak om lo ahih manin kisuikha hi,” ci hi.
Hih thute a gen khit ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “I lawmpa Lazarus ihmu khinta hi. Himah taleh amah a phong dingin ka pai ding hi,” ci hi.
Nungzuite in, “Topa aw, amah ihmu khinta ahihleh noptuam ta ding hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu' gen pen Lazarus' sihna thu hi a, ahi zongin nungzuite in ihmut ngeina a gen mah sa uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah siangtak gen a, “Lazarus si khinta hi.
Na up theih nadingun tua takah om lo ka hih manin no teng kong ngaihsutna-in ka nuam hi. Himah taleh tu-in ama' kiang va pai ni,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin (Didymus a kici) Thomas in a nungzuihpihte' kiangah, “Amah tawh a sikhawm dingin ei zong va pai ni,” ci hi.
Jesu a tun ciangin hankhuk sungah Lazarus a kivui zawh ni li na pha khinta hi.
Bethany pen Jerusalem tawh kinai a, tai nih kiim pha hi.
A sanggampa uh' nusiat huhau-in Martha leh Mary a hehnem dingin Jew mite tampi na om uh hi.
Jesu hong pai cih Martha in a zak ciangin a dawn dingin va pai a, Mary ahihleh inn sungah tu hi.
Martha in Jesu' kiangah, “Topa aw, hih takah om hilehcin ka sanggampa si lo ding hi.
Tu nangawnin zong Pasian' kiangah na nget peuhpeuh Pasian in hong pia ding cih ka thei hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Na sanggampa thokik ding hi,” ci hi.
Martha in, “Ni tawpni thawhkikna hun ah amah hong thokik ding cih ka thei hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Kei pen thawhkikna leh nuntakna ka hi hi. Kei hong um peuhmah a sih hangin nungta ding hi.
Kei hong umin kei' sungah a nungta khempeuh a tawntungin si ngeilo ding uh hi. Hih thu na um hiam?” ci hi.
Martha in, “Topa aw, himah hi. Nang pen leitunga hong pai Pasian' Tapa, Khris na hih kong um hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu a gen khit ciangin Martha paikhia-in a sanggamnu Mary sam a, “Syapa hong tungin nang hong kan hi,” ci-in gen sim hi.
Tua a zak ciangin Mary zong manlangtak dingto-in Jesu' kiangah pai hi.
Jesu khuasung lut nailo a, Martha' dawntuahna mun ah omlai hi.
Inn sungah Mary tutpihin a hehnem Jew mite in Mary manlangtak dingto-in a paikhiat a muh uh ciangin hankhuk ah a va kap dinga pai ci-in ngaihsun uh ahih manin zuikhia uh hi.
Jesu' omna mun ah Mary tungin Jesu a muh ciangin a khe-phung ah boksuk a, “Topa aw, hih takah om hilehcin ka sanggampa si lo ding hi,” ci hi.
Mary leh amah tawh hong tonkhawm Jew mite' kah a muh ciangin Jesu a lungsim nakpi sukha-in lunggim mahmah hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, “Amah koi ah sial na hi uh hiam?” ci hi. Amaute in, “Topa aw, hong pai inla en in,” ci uh hi.
Jesu kap hi.
Tua ciangin Jew mite in, “En un, Lazarus a it luatdan!” ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin kimkhat in, “Khuamulo mite' mit a honsakpa in Lazarus zong a sih loh nading bawl theilo ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu a lungsim nakpi sukha leuleu ahih manin hankhuk ah pai hi. Hankhuk pen kuahawm khat hi a, suangtum khat tawh kihu hi.
Jesu in, “Suangtum hemkhia un,” ci hi. Misipa' sanggamnu Martha in, “Topa aw, amah a sih zawh ni li pha ta ahih manin tu-in ahihleh nam ta ding hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Na up leh Pasian' minpha na mu ding hi hong ci khin hilo ka hi hiam?” ci hi.
Tua ciangin mite in suangtum hemkhia uh hi. Jesu zong vantung lam dakto-in, “Pa aw, ka thu hong ngai na hih manin nong hehpihna kong phat hi.
Ka thu hong ngai den na hihlam ka thei a, ahi zongin hih taka om mite in kei nong sawlna thu a up theih nadingun amaute ka ngaihsutna tawh hih bangin a pau ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu teng a gen khit ciangin Jesu awging lianpi tawh kiko a, “Lazarus, hong pusuak in!” ci hi.
A si khinsa mipa zong hong pusuak a, misi dialpi tawh a khut a khete kitunin puanbek tawh a maitang kituam hi. Jesu in, “Amah phel unla, paikhiasak un,” ci-in tua mite sawl hi.
Tua ahih manin Mary tawh hong tonkhawm, Jesu' sep teng a mu, Jew mite tampitak in Jesu um uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute kimkhat Pharisee-te' kiang pai uh a, Jesu' sep thu teng gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampi liante leh Pharisee-te in Sanhedrin kikhop sam uh a, “Bangci hih ding i hi hiam? Hih mipa in kihilna lim tampi bawl hi.
I hici koihsuak leh mi khempeuh in amah um ding uh a, Rome mite hong pai-in i mun i mual leh i minam hong hemkhia ding uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute' lakah tua kum ai siampi lianpenpa a sem Caiaphas in, “Bangmah na thei kei uh hi.
Minam bup a siat ding sangin mipite' taangin mi khat si leh note' ading hoihzaw cih na tel kei uh hi,” ci hi.
Hih pen ama' ut thu tawh a genkhiat hilo a, tua kum ai siampi lianpenpa ahihna tawh minam bup taangin Jesu si ding cih thu, kamsanna tawh a genkhol ahi hi.
Bek thamlo, Jesu' sih ding pen minam bup tang bek hilo-in a kithehthang Pasian' tate minam khatin a kaikhawm ding, a cihna zong ahi hi.
Tua ciangin tua ni-a kipan Jesu thah theih nading thu vaihawm uh hi.
Tua hangin Jesu zong Jew mite lakah a langtangin vak nawnlo a, tua lai panin gamgawtak geinai gam sung, Ephraim a kici khua ah pai-in tua lai-ah nungzuite tawh taam hi.
Tu-in Jew mite' Paisan Pawi hun nai ta a, Paisan Pawi ma kisiansuahna bawl dingin gamsung pan mi tampitak Jerusalem ah pai uh hi.
Amaute in Jesu zong uh a, biakinnpi huang sungah a din kawmun khatlekhat kiho-in, “Na bangci ngaihsut hiam? Amah pawi ah hong pai vet lo ding ahi hiam?” kici uh hi.
Tu-in siampi liante leh Pharisee-te in Jesu a mat theih nadingun Jesu' omna a thei peuhpeuh in thu a koh nadingin thupiakna nei khinzo uh hi.
